answer: Like a willow that bends but holds, an identity earns full rights only after an ember rite: it must permanently burn 25,000 POA of its own earned rewards to climb from the low knoll of capped jobs to the full tier. Skipping the burn keeps earnings capped at 10%; forged activity triggers a burn of the whole earned balance plus a ban of eight epochs. One fake costs 25,000 POA to activate, so 1,000 fakes burn 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent burns 25,000 once. Weakness: if POA trades cheaply, a rich attacker can simply buy the burn.
